activity_summary: Nick stopped at the girl's entrance and did not speak her verse. He said she knows nothing of the boy, and of the man only a name and a face across a hall, and that she is careful, not shy. You wrote it down. Kemp played the servant straight and did not ask for a song. Burbage said the boy had read too many sonnets, and you said he had. Pope liked the old man better. You did not let Kemp see that you were pleased.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Asked what she knows, and wrote the answer.

entities.context: Said the boy talks like a man who has read too many sonnets.

facets.activity: Wrote down that she is careful

quotes.speaker: nick_sorrell
quotes.text: Then she's not shy, master. She's only careful.

quotes.speaker: richard_burbage
quotes.text: The boy at the feast talks like a man who has read too many sonnets.
